When I heard my Guru speak of Lord Hara as a votary of Sri Hari, my heart, O lord of the feathered kingdom, was all on fire. Vile of descent as I was, the little learning that I had acquired turned my head even as a serpent becomes all the more poisonous when fed on milk.
जे सठ गुर सन इरिषा करहीं। रौरव नरक कोटि जुग परहीं॥
त्रिजग जोनि पुनि धरहिं सरीरा। अयुत जन्म भरि पावहिं पीरा॥3॥
jē saṭha gura sana iriṣā karahīṃ. raurava naraka kōṭi juga parahīṃ..
trijaga jōni puni dharahiṃ sarīrā. ayuta janma bhari pāvahiṃ pīrā..
The fools who bear malice against their Guru are cast into the hell named Raurava for a myriad Yugas. After that they take birth in the subhuman species and suffer torment for ten thousand successive existence.
तुषाराद्रि संकाश गौरं गभीरं। मनोभूत कोटि प्रभा श्रीशरीरं॥
स्फुरन्मौलि कल्लोलिनी चारु गंगा। लसद्भालबालेन्दु कंठे भुजंगा॥3॥
tuṣārādri saṃkāśa gauraṃ gabhīraṃ. manōbhūta kōṭi prabhā śrī śarīraṃ..
sphuranmauli kallōlinī cāru gaṃgā. lasadbhālabālēndu kaṃṭhē bhujaṃgā..
who is possessed of a form white as the snowclad Himalaya, and radiant with the beauty of a myriad Cupids, whose head sparkles with the lovely stream of the Ganga, whose brow is adorned by the crescent moon and neck coiled by serpents,
मोर श्राप द्विज ब्यर्थ न जाइहि। जन्म सहस अवस्य यह पाइहि॥3॥
chamāsīla jē para upakārī. tē dvija mōhi priya jathā kharārī..
mōra śrāpa dvija byartha na jāihi. janma sahasa avasya yaha pāihi..
O holy Brahmana, they who are of a forgiving disposition and beneficent are as dear to Me as Sri Rama (the Slayer of the demon Khara) Himself. Nonetheless, O Brahmana, My curse shall not go in vain : this fellow shall surely pass through a thousand incarnations.
प्रौढ़ भएँ मोहि पिता पढ़ावा। समझउँ सुनउँ गुनउँ नहिं भावा॥
मन ते सकल बासना भागी। केवल राम चरन लय लागी॥3॥
prauḍha bhaēom mōhi pitā paḍhaāvā. samajhauom sunauom gunauom nahiṃ bhāvā..
mana tē sakala bāsanā bhāgī. kēvala rāma carana laya lāgī.
As I grew up my father gave me lessons (in secular subjects). I tried to understand things, listened to the lessons and reflected on them; yet they failed to attract my mind. All worldly cravings left my soul; I was solely absorbed in the thought of Sri Rama’s feet.
मन गोतीत अमल अबिनासी। निर्बिकार निरवधि सुख रासी॥
सो तैं ताहि तोहि नहिं भेदा। बारि बीचि इव गावहिं बेदा॥3॥
mana gōtīta amala abināsī. nirbikāra niravadhi sukha rāsī..
sō taiṃ tāhi tōhi nahiṃ bhēdā. bāri bīci iva gāvahi bēdā.
beyond the mind and the senses, immaculate and indestructible, immutable, unlimited and all-blissful : “You are identical with the Brahma referred to above; no more difference exists between Him and you than between a sheet of water and the ripples on its surface: so declare the Vedas.”
भव कि परहिं परमात्मा बिंदक। सुखी कि होहिं कबहुँ हरिनिंदक॥
राजु कि रहइ नीति बिनु जानें। अघ कि रहहिं हरिचरित बखानें॥3॥
bhava ki parahiṃ paramātmā biṃdaka. sukhī ki hōhiṃ kabahuom hariniṃdaka..
rāju ki rahai nīti binu jānēṃ. agha ki rahahiṃ haricarita bakhānēṃ..
Can those who have realized God fall again into the ocean of transmigration? Can the revilers of Sri Hari be ever happy? Can a kingdom stand without a knowledge of statecraft? Can sins persist even after one has commenced narrating Sri Hari’s exploits? Can one enjoy sacred renown without religious merit and can anyone earn a bad reputation without a sin?
अति बिसमय पुनि पुनि पछिताई। सादर मुनि मोहि लीन्ह बोलाई॥
मम परितोष बिबिधि बिधि कीन्हा। हरषित राममंत्र तब दीन्हा॥3॥
ati bisamaya puni puni pachitāī. sādara muni mōhi līnha bōlāī..
mama paritōṣa bibidha bidhi kīnhā. haraṣita rāmamaṃtra taba dīnhā..
He consoled me in everyway and then gladly imparted to me the formula sacred to Sri Rama. The gracious sage also taught me how to meditate on Sri Rama as a child.
सुनि मुनि आसिष सुनु मतिधीरा। ब्रह्मगिरा भइ गगन गँभीरा॥
एवमस्तु तव बच मुनि ग्यानी। यह मम भगत कर्म मन बानी॥3॥
suni muni āsiṣa sunu matidhīrā. brahmagirā bhai gagana gaombhīrā..
ēvamastu tava baca muni gyānī. yaha mama bhagata karma mana bānī..
On hearing the sage’s benediction, mark me, O Garuda of steadfast reason, a deep voice-which was evidently the voice of the Supreme Spirit-was heard from the heavens: “May your prophesy come to be true, O enlightened sage !
तव प्रसाद प्रभु मम उर माहीं। संसय सोक मोह भ्रम नाहीं॥3॥
suni bhasuṃḍi kē bacana bhavānī. bōlēu garuḍa haraṣi mṛdu bānī..
tava prasāda prabhu mama ura māhīṃ. saṃsaya sōka mōha bhrama nāhīṃ..
Garuda, O Bhavani, (continues Lord Sankara,) rejoiced to hear Bhusundi’s words and submitted in gentle accents : “By your grace, my lord, doubt, sorrow, error and delusion have disappeared from my heart.
भगतिहि सानुकूल रघुराया। ताते तेहि डरपति अति माया॥
राम भगति निरुपम निरुपाधी। बसइ जासु उर सदा अबाधी॥3॥
bhagatihi sānukūla raghurāyā. tātē tēhi ḍarapati ati māyā..
rāma bhagati nirupama nirupādhī. basai jāsu ura sadā abādhī..
The Lord of the Raghus is well-disposed towards Bhakti; hence Maya is terribly afraid of her. Nay, Maya shrinks at the very sight of the man in whose heart ever abides unobstructed the peerless and guileless spirit of Devotion,
तब ते जीव भयउ संसारी। छूट न ग्रंथि न होइ सुखारी॥
श्रुति पुरान बहु कहेउ उपाई। छूट न अधिक अधिक अरुझाई॥3॥
taba tē jīva bhayau saṃsārī. chūṭa na graṃthi na hōi sukhārī..
śruti purāna bahu kahēu upāī. chūṭa na adhika adhika arujhāī..
Since then the soul has become worldly: it can have no happiness till this knot is untied. The Vedas and Puranas have suggested a number of devices for untying the knot; but the knot, far from being resolved, becomes harder and harder.
छोरन ग्रंथि पाव जौं सोई। तब यह जीव कृतारथ होई॥
छोरत ग्रंथ जानि खगराया। बिघ्न नेक करइ तब माया॥3॥
chōrana graṃthi pāva jauṃ sōī. taba yaha jīva kṛtāratha hōī..
chōrata graṃthi jāni khagarāyā. bighna anēka karai taba māyā..
The soul can hope to attain its object only in the event of Buddhi succeeding in untying it. But when Maya, O king of the birds, finds her attempting to untie the knot, she creates many difficulties.
जिमि थल बिनु जल रहि न सकाई। कोटि भाँति कोउ करै उपाई॥
तथा मोच्छ सुख सुनु खगराई। रहि न सकइ हरि भगति बिहाई॥3॥
jimi thala binu jala rahi na sakāī. kōṭi bhāomti kōu karai upāī..
tathā mōccha sukha sunu khagarāī. rahi na sakai hari bhagati bihāī..
Water cannot stay except on land notwithstanding our best efforts; even so, mark you, O king of the birds, the joy of final beatitude cannot stay apart from Devotion to Sri Hari.
प्रबल अबिद्या तम मिटि जाई। हारहिं सकल सलभ समुदाई॥
खल कामादि निकट नहिं जाहीं। बसइ भगति जाके उर माहीं॥3॥
prabala abidyā tama miṭi jāī. hārahiṃ sakala salabha samudāī..
khala kāmādi nikaṭa nahiṃ jāhīṃ. basai bhagati jākē ura māhīṃ.
which dispels the overpowering gloom of ignorance and the swarms of moths (in the shape of vanity etc.,) keep away from it in a mood of frustration. Nay, vicious propensities like lust dare not approach him in whose heart the gem of Devotion abides.
कवन पुन्य श्रुति बिदित बिसाला। कहहु कवन अघ परम कराला॥3॥
saṃta asaṃta marama tumha jānahu. tinha kara sahaja subhāva bakhānahu..
kavana punya śruti bidita bisālā. kahahu kavana agha parama karālā..
You know the essential characteristics of the saints and the evil-minded; therefore, describe their innate disposition. Also tell me which is the highest religious merit made known in the Vedas and which, again, is the most terrible sin.
राम कृपाँ नासहिं सब रोगा। जौं एहि भाँति बनै संजोगा॥
सदगुर बैद बचन बिस्वासा। संजम यह न बिषय कै आसा॥3॥
rāma kṛpāom nāsahi saba rōgā. jauṃ ēhi bhāomti banai saṃyōgā..
sadagura baida bacana bisvāsā. saṃjama yaha na biṣaya kai āsā..
All these ailments can no doubt be eradicated if by Sri Rama’s grace the following factors combine. There must be faith in the words of the physician in the form of a true preceptor; and the regimen is indifference to the pleasures of sense.
चौपाई
| CHAUPAIS :
पूँछिहु राम कथा अति पावनि। सुक सनकादि संभु मन भावनि॥
सत संगति दुर्लभ संसारा। निमिष दंड भरि एकउ बारा॥3॥
pūchihuom rāma kathā ati pāvani. suka sanakādi saṃbhu mana bhāvani..
sata saṃgati durlabha saṃsārā. nimiṣa daṃḍa bhari ēkau bārā..
in that you asked me to repeat the most sacred story of Sri Rama, which delights the soul of sages like Suka, Sanaka and others, as well as of Lord Sambhu. The fellowship of saints is difficult to get in this world, be it for the twinkling of an eye or for half an hour even for once.
साधक सिद्ध बिमुक्त उदासी। कबि कोबिद कृतग्य संन्यासी॥
जोगी सूर सुतापस ग्यानी। धर्म निरत पंडित बिग्यानी॥3॥
sādhaka siddha bimukta udāsī. kabi kōbida kṛtagya saṃnyāsī..
jōgī sūra sutāpasa gyānī. dharma nirata paṃḍita bigyānī..
Strivers and perfect souls, the liberated and the unworldly-minded, the seers and learned men, those knowing the secrets of Karma (duty) and those who have renounced all action, Yogis (mystics), and valiant heroes, great ascetics and wise men, pious souls and men of erudition and even men who have realized the Self-
पूरन काम राम अनुरागी। तुम्ह सम तात न कोउ बड़भागी॥
pūrana kāma rāma anurāgī. tumha sama tāta na kōu baḍabhāgī..
saṃta biṭapa saritā giri dharanī. para hita hētu sabanha kai karanī..
You are fully satiated and a lover of Sri Rama; no one is so blessed as you, venerable sir. Saints, trees, rivers, mountains and the earth, all these operate for the good of others.
saṃta hṛdaya navanīta samānā. kahā kabinha pari kahai na jānā..
nija paritāpa dravai navanītā. para dukha dravahiṃ saṃta supunītā..
The poets have declared the heart of a saint to be soft as butter; but they did not know what should be said. For, while butter melts only when the same is heated on fire, the holy saints melt at the suffering of others.
नाना कर्म धर्म ब्रत दाना। संजम दम जप तप मख नाना॥
भूत दया द्विज गुर सेवकाई। बिद्या बिनय बिबेक बड़ाई॥3॥
nānā karma dharma brata dānā. saṃjama dama japa tapa makha nānā..
bhūta dayā dvija gura sēvakāī. bidyā binaya bibēka baḍaāī..
sacred rites and religious practices, vows and charitable acts of various kinds, self-denial and self-control, Japa (muttering of prayers) and austere penance, performing manifold sacrifices, compassion to all living beings, ministering to the Brahmanas and one’s preceptor, learning, modesty, right judgment and nobility of mind and character, in short,
धन्य देस सो जहँ सुरसरी। धन्य नारि पतिब्रत अनुसरी॥
धन्य सो भूपु नीति जो करई। धन्य सो द्विज निज धर्म न टरई॥3॥
dhanya dēsa sō jahaom surasarī. dhanya nāri patibrata anusarī..
dhanya sō bhūpu nīti jō karaī. dhanya sō dvija nija dharma na ṭaraī..
Blessed is the land where flows the celestial stream (the Ganga); blessed the wife who observes a vow of fidelity to her husband. Blessed is the monarch who administers justice; blessed the Brahmana who swerves not from his duty.
द्विज द्रोहिहि न सुनाइअ कबहूँ। सुरपति सरिस होइ नृप जबहूँ॥
dvija drōhihi na sunāia kabahūom. surapati sarisa hōi nṛpa jabahūom..
rāma kathā kē tēi adhikārī. jinha kēṃ satasaṃgati ati pyārī..
It should never be repeated to a Brahmana-hater, be he a monarch as great as Indra (the lord of the celestials). They alone are qualified to hear Sri Rama’s narrative, who are extremely fond of communion with holy men.
मन कामना सिद्धि नर पावा। जे यह कथा कपट तजि गावा॥
कहहिं सुनहिं अनुमोदन करहीं। ते गोपद इव भवनिधि तरहीं॥3॥
mana kāmanā siddhi nara pāvā. jē yaha kathā kapaṭa taji gāvā..
kahahiṃ sunahiṃ anumōdana karahīṃ. tē gōpada iva bhavanidhi tarahīṃ..
Men who sing this story in a guileless spirit attain the object of their soul’s desire. Nay, they who repeat or listen to it or even approve of its recitation cross the ocean of mundane existence as they would the print of a cow’s hoof.
एहिं कलिकाल न साधन दूजा। जोग जग्य जप तप ब्रत पूजा॥
रामहि सुमिरिअ गाइअ रामहि। संतत सुनिअ राम गुन ग्रामहि॥3॥
ēhiṃ kalikāla na sādhana dūjā. jōga jagya japa tapa brata pūjā..
rāmahi sumiria gāia rāmahi. saṃtata sunia rāma guna grāmahi..
In this age of Kali no other discipline is of any avail-neither Yoga (mind-control) nor sacrifices, nor Japa (muttering of prayers) not austere penance nor any sacred vows nor ritual : Rama alone should be remembered, Rama alone should be glorified; and it is the catalogue of Rama’s virtues alone that should be given ear to.
जाकी कृपा लवलेस ते मतिमंद तुलसीदासहूँ।
पायो परम बिश्रामु राम समान प्रभु नाहीं कहूँ॥3॥
suṃdara sujāna kṛpā nidhāna anātha para kara prīti jō.
sō ēka rāma akāma hita nirbānaprada sama āna kō..
jākī kṛpā lavalēsa tē matimaṃda tulasīdāsahūom.
pāyō parama biśrāmu rāma samāna prabhu nāhīṃ kahūom..3..
If there is anyone who is all-beautiful, all-wise and all-merciful and who is fond of the forlorn, it is Rama and Rama alone; who else can compare with Him as a disinterested friend and a bestower of eternal bliss? Nowhere can we find a lord like Sri Rama, by an iota of whose grace even the dull-witted Tulasidasa has found supreme peace.
दोहा
| Dohas:
मो सम दीन न दीन हित तुम्ह समान रघुबीर।
अस बिचारि रघुबंस मनि हरहु बिषम भव भीर॥130 क॥
mō sama dīna na dīna hita tumha samāna raghubīra.
asa bicāri raghubaṃsa mani harahu biṣama bhava bhīra..130ka..
There is no one so miserable as I nor such a friend of the miserable as You, O Hero of Raghu’s line ! Realizing this, O Jewel of Raghu’s race, take away my fear of transmigration, which is so terrible.
कामिहि नारि पिआरि जिमि लोभिहि प्रिय जिमि दाम।
तिमि रघुनाथ निरंतर प्रिय लागहु मोहि राम॥130 ख॥
kāmihi nāri piāri jimi lōbhahi priya jimi dāma.
timi raghunātha niraṃtara priya lāgahu mōhi rāma..130kha..
May You be ever so dear to me, Rama, as woman is dear to a lustful man, and as lucre is dear to the greedy, O Lord of the Raghus.
श्लोक
| Shloka:
:

verses.title: रामचरितमानस, उत्तरकाण्ड, दोहा/चौपाई 4
verses.author: गोस्वामी तुलसीदास, रामचरितमानस
tags: RamCharitManas Uttar Kand in English Transliteration Meaning Translation
verses.sanskrit_text:
मोरे जियँ भरोस दृढ़ सोई। मिलिहहिं राम सगुन सुभ होई॥
बीतें अवधि रहहिं जौं प्राना। अधम कवन जग मोहि समाना॥4॥
mōri jiyaom bharōsa dṛḍha sōī. milihahiṃ rāma saguna subha hōī..
bītēṃ avadhi rahahi jauṃ prānā. adhama kavana jaga mōhi samānā..
I have a firm conviction in my heart that Sri Rama will surely meet me; for the omens are so propitious. But, if I outlive the expiry of the time-limit, no one would be so despicable in this world as I.”
दोहा | Dohas:
राम बिरह सागर महँ भरत मगन मन होत।
बिप्र रूप धरि पवनसुत आइ गयउ जनु पोत॥1क॥
rāma biraha sāgara mahaom bharata magana mana hōta.
bipra rūpa dhari pavana suta āi gayau janu pōta..1ka..
While Bharata’s mind was thus sinking in the ocean of separation from Sri Rama, the son of the wind-god, disguised as a Brahmana, came like a bark to his rescue.
बैठे देखि कुसासन जटा मुकुट कृस गात॥
राम राम रघुपति जपत स्रवत नयन जलजात॥1ख॥
baiṭhi dēkhi kusāsana jaṭā mukuṭa kṛsa gāta.
rāma rāma raghupati japata stravata nayana jalajāta..1kha..
He (Hanuman Ji) found Bharata seated on a mat of Kusa grass, emaciated in body, with a coil of matted hair for a crown and the words, “Rama, Rama, Raghupati” on his lips, his lotus eyes streaming with tears.
मारुत सुत मैं कपि हनुमाना। नामु मोर सुनु कृपानिधाना॥4॥
kō tumha tāta kahāom tē āē. mōhi parama priya bacana sunāē..
māruta suta maiṃ kapi hanumānā. nāmu mōra sunu kṛpānidhānā..
(Bharat Ji asked) “Who are you, my beloved friend, and whence have you come? You have told me a most pleasing news.” ” Listen, O fountain of mercy: I am the son of the wind-god, a monkey; Hanuman is my name.
जे जैसेहिं तैसेहिं उठि धावहिं। बाल बृद्ध कहँ संग न लावहिं॥
एक एकन्ह कहँ बूझहिं भाई। तुम्ह देखे दयाल रघुराई॥4॥
jē jaisēhiṃ taisēhiṃ uṭi dhāvahiṃ. bāla bṛddha kahaom saṃga na lāvahiṃ..
ēka ēkanha kahaom būjhahiṃ bhāī. tumha dēkhē dayāla raghurāī..
All ran out just as they happened to be and did not take children or old folk with them. People asked one another: “Brother, did you see the gracious Lord of the Raghus?”
हरषे सब कपि सुनि प्रभु बानी। धन्य अवध जो राम बखानी॥4॥
ati priya mōhi ihāom kē bāsī. mama dhāmadā purī sukha rāsī..
haraṣē saba kapi suni prabhu bānī. dhanya avadha jō rāma bakhānī..
The dwellers here are very dear to Me; the city is not only full of bliss itself but bestows a residence in My divine Abode.” The monkeys were all delighted to hear these words of the Lord and said, “Blessed indeed is Ayodhya, that has evoked praise from Sri Rama Himself !”
